# IConfigurationManager
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/config-contracts/src/interfaces/IConfigurationManager.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IConfigurationManagerEvents](../events/i-configuration-manager-events.md), [IConfigurationManagerErrors](../errors/i-configuration-manager-errors.md)

**Title:**
IConfigurationManager

Interface for the ConfigurationManager contract, which manages system-wide parameters

This interface defines the getters and setters for system-wide parameters


## Functions
### initializeConfiguration

Initialize the configuration with the given parameters

Can only be called by the governor


```solidity
function initializeConfiguration(ConfigurationManagerParams memory params) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`params`|`ConfigurationManagerParams`|The parameters to initialize the configuration with|


### raft

Get the address of the Raft contract

This is where rewards and farmed tokens are sent for processing


```solidity
function raft() external view returns (address);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|The address of the Raft contract|


### tipJar

Get the current tip jar address

This is the contract that owns tips and is responsible for

```

### treasury

```
